primary_source_receipts.claim: 79% of active large-cap US funds underperformed the S&P 500 in 2025
primary_source_receipts.finding: SPIVA U.S. Year-End 2025: about 79% of active large-cap funds trailed the S&P 500 (65% in 2024); available before publication. 15-year 90% and 22-category claims not checked.

primary_source_receipts.claim: 41.4% cash out 401(k) at job separation; 85% empty accounts
primary_source_receipts.finding: Wang, Zhai and Lynch, Marketing Science 42(4) 2023: 162,360 terminating employees, 28 plans, 41.4% cashed out; ~64% emptied in one withdrawal plus ~21% over several (85%). $266,000 lifetime cost not found.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Vanguard 10-year US equity outlook roughly 4 to 6%
primary_source_receipts.finding: December 2025 outlook 4.0-5.0%; January 2026 model run about 3.9-5.9% annualized, nominal. Consistent with narrator's range but nominal, so '6% real' exceeds it. Goldman 6.5% not checked.

primary_source_receipts.claim: Fidelity about 850,000 401(k) millionaires, about 26 years of saving
primary_source_receipts.finding: Record 769,000 401(k) millionaires at end of June 2026, average saving tenure about 25 years; narrator's 850,000 not matched. 1.5% share not checked.

primary_source_receipts.claim: 20 years through 2025 ~7x; missing 10 best days ~half; 7 of 10 best days within two weeks of worst; Morningstar 7-day median gap
primary_source_receipts.access_scope: SEARCH_EXCERPT_ONLY; no primary source for the specific figures found
primary_source_receipts.finding: UNVERIFIED: only 2025 single-year and older 1995-2014 J.P. Morgan figures found; specific 20-year multiple, halving and seven-day statistics not confirmed.

calculation_receipts.method: Analyst Python: $100,000 start, end-of-month contributions, nominal annual rate compounded monthly (annual-compounding variants also computed), no fees/taxes; fees subtracted from annual return; inflation by constant 2.5%; back-solves for unstated contributions
